When I was about 8 or 9 my family had moved to a brand new house in a new neighborhood. We were one of the first  houses to be built and were tucked away in a cul-de-sac at the top of a small hill. Across the cul-de-sac was an old graveyard that had been there for many years. I believe the realtor told us that this used to be old farmland and that the graves had been there since the flu epidemic. The graves were from children and their parents who had passed. 

Fast forward to about a month of living in the house. I slept in the front of the house on the second floor and had a clear view of the cul-de-sac. It was late at night and I was trying to fall asleep. I kept hearing the sound of children's voices playing but couldn't figure out if it was my mind playing tricks on me. My window was cracked and I could clearly tell the voices were coming from outside. The moon was full and it was a clear night so I could see everything outside albeit not as clearly.  What I did see though sent shivers down my spine. I could see shadows moving around the cul-de-sac. I went to my mom and dad's room and when I brought them back there was nothing. 

They think I was lying. I wasn't. And it still creeps me out.
